headline: Multiplan Expands São Paulo Mall with R$400 Million Investment
summary: Multiplan completed a R$ 400 million three-year expansion, opening 40 new stores to strengthen retail, dining, and wellness options.
why: Multiplan is one of Brazil's largest commercial real estate developers, managing high-end shopping centers across major metropolitan areas.

impacts.name: Multiplan
impacts.why: Expanding retail capacity in premier locations increases potential leasing revenue.
